clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.
clinical_governance.baseline_and_regular_tests: Baseline: FBC, renal and liver profile, glucose and thyroid function; audiology as indicated. Regular: day 1 FBC, renal and liver profile, day 8 FBC and creatinine while receiving chemotherapy, glucose and thyroid function; cortisol as clinically indicated (page 3).

action.recommendation: Known hypersensitivity to any of the three agents or relevant excipients is a regimen exclusion. Confirm the implicated medicine and a new plan.

rules.explanation: Known hypersensitivity to any of the three agents or relevant excipients is a regimen exclusion. Confirm the implicated medicine and a new plan.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy and breastfeeding are listed exclusions for this regimen. Obtain consultant review.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy and breastfeeding are listed exclusions for this regimen. Obtain consultant review.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab until the infection is clinically stable.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 infection requires withholding until stable.

action.recommendation: Review abnormal blood counts against the treatment day and Table 3. The combination and maintenance phases have different components.

rules.explanation: Review abnormal blood counts against the treatment day and Table 3. The combination and maintenance phases have different components.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab and manage as immune-mediated pneumonitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 immune-mediated pneumonitis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for grade 3–4 pneumonitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 immune-mediated pneumonitis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab for the intermediate immune-hepatitis thresholds pending evaluation. Higher or concurrent findings may require permanent discontinuation. Check for biliary obstruction or another cause.

rules.explanation: Withhold durvalumab for the intermediate immune-hepatitis thresholds pending evaluation. Higher or concurrent findings may require permanent discontinuation. Check for biliary obstruction or another cause.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for ALT/AST >10× ULN, isolated bilirubin >3× ULN, or ALT/AST >3× with bilirubin >2× ULN and no alternative cause. Apply the AST/ALT recommendations if the concurrent bilirubin rise has an alternative cause.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for ALT/AST >10× ULN, isolated bilirubin >3× ULN, or ALT/AST >3× with bilirubin >2× ULN and no alternative cause. Apply the AST/ALT recommendations if the concurrent bilirubin rise has an alternative cause.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab and manage the immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis pathway.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 immune-mediated diarrhoea or colitis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for grade 4 immune-mediated diarrhoea/colitis.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 immune-mediated diarrhoea or colitis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab until clinically stable; treat hyperthyroidism/thyroiditis as indicated.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–4 immune-mediated hyperthyroidism or thyroiditis requires withholding until stable.

action.recommendation: Durvalumab dose change is not required solely for hypothyroidism; initiate thyroid replacement and confirm clinical stability.

rules.explanation: Immune-mediated hypothyroidism is treated with hormone replacement without a protocol dose change.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab until clinically stable and initiate corticosteroid/hormone replacement as indicated.

rules.explanation: Symptomatic adrenal insufficiency or hypophysitis requires withholding until stable.

action.recommendation: Endocrinopathy controlled on replacement therapy does not automatically require permanent discontinuation; confirm stability.

rules.explanation: Controlled endocrinopathies are an exception to the general permanent-discontinuation rule.

action.recommendation: Urgently assess and treat suspected immune-mediated diabetes with insulin as clinically indicated; the protocol does not require an automatic durvalumab dose change solely for controlled type 1 diabetes.

rules.explanation: Immune-mediated type 1 diabetes is managed with insulin without a protocol dose change.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab and manage as immune-mediated nephritis.

rules.explanation: Creatinine >1.5–3× baseline or ULN meets the grade 2 nephritis pathway.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for grade 3–4 immune-mediated nephritis.

rules.explanation: Creatinine >3× baseline or ULN meets the permanent-discontinuation pathway.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab for grade 2 rash lasting more than one week.

rules.explanation: Grade 2 immune-mediated rash lasting more than one week requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab and manage the grade 3 rash pathway.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 immune-mediated rash requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for grade 4 immune-mediated rash.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 immune-mediated rash requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab and urgently manage suspected immune-mediated myocarditis.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–4 myocarditis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab and manage immune-mediated myositis/polymyositis.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 myositis requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for grade 4 myositis.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 myositis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Urgently clarify the neurological syndrome and grade. Grade 2 meningitis needs interruption; transverse myelitis at any grade requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Urgently clarify the neurological syndrome and grade. Grade 2 meningitis needs interruption; transverse myelitis at any grade requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Interrupt or slow the durvalumab infusion for a grade 1 or 2 reaction. Assess and manage the reaction according to the unit protocol.

rules.explanation: Interrupt or slow the durvalumab infusion for a grade 1 or 2 reaction. Assess and manage the reaction according to the unit protocol.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for a grade 3–4 infusion reaction.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 infusion reactions require permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab for other grade 2 or 3 immune-mediated reactions. Use the specific organ rule where available.

rules.explanation: Withhold durvalumab for other grade 2 or 3 immune-mediated reactions. Use the specific organ rule where available.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for grade 4 immune-mediated toxicity, except controlled endocrinopathies.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 immune-mediated toxicity generally requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue durvalumab for recurrent grade 3 immune-mediated toxicity.

rules.explanation: Recurrent grade 3 immune-mediated toxicity requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab until the adverse reaction returns to grade 1 or baseline.

rules.explanation: Grade 2–3 non-immune adverse reactions require withholding.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue for a grade 4 non-immune adverse event other than an isolated laboratory abnormality.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue for a grade 4 non-immune adverse event other than an isolated laboratory abnormality.

action.recommendation: Prior grade ≥3 or unresolved >grade 1 immune toxicity is a source-listed caution: obtain consultant review before initiating or resuming therapy.

rules.explanation: Prior grade ≥3 or unresolved >grade 1 immune toxicity is a source-listed caution: obtain consultant review before initiating or resuming therapy.

action.recommendation: Withhold treatment and treat/review the clinically significant infection until stable.

rules.explanation: Active clinically significant infection requiring therapy is a caution.

action.recommendation: Withhold and urgently assess/treat suspected cholangitis or biliary tract infection.

rules.explanation: Biliary tract infection/cholangitis requires close monitoring and treatment review.

action.recommendation: If durvalumab is due: use 20 mg/kg at body weight ≤36 kg. It is given on day 1 every 21 days during induction and every 28 days during maintenance.

rules.explanation: Patients ≤36 kg require weight-based durvalumab dosing.

action.recommendation: Give gemcitabine at 75%; cisplatin remains at 100% according to Table 3.

rules.explanation: ANC 0.5–0.99 or platelets 50–100 requires gemcitabine 75% and cisplatin 100%.

action.recommendation: Omit gemcitabine and cisplatin for this treatment day. Assess durvalumab separately using the immune-toxicity pathway.

rules.explanation: ANC <0.5 or platelets <50 requires omission of gemcitabine and cisplatin.

action.recommendation: Give cisplatin at 75% of the original dose.

rules.explanation: CrCl 50–59 mL/min requires cisplatin 75%.

action.recommendation: Give cisplatin at 50% of the original dose.

rules.explanation: CrCl 40–49 mL/min requires cisplatin 50%.

action.recommendation: Cisplatin is not recommended at CrCl below 40 mL/min; obtain consultant/pharmacy review of the regimen.

rules.explanation: Cisplatin is not recommended below CrCl 40 mL/min.

action.recommendation: In haemodialysis, 50% cisplatin may be considered; specialist consultant/pharmacy review is required.

rules.explanation: The source permits consideration of 50% cisplatin in haemodialysis.

action.recommendation: Consider starting gemcitabine at 80% and increasing if tolerated, or full dose with active monitoring.

rules.explanation: Bilirubin ≥27 µmol/L requires an 80% start or active monitoring option.

action.recommendation: Significant hearing impairment/tinnitus is an exclusion for cisplatin; obtain consultant review.

rules.explanation: Significant hearing impairment/tinnitus is an exclusion.

action.recommendation: Confirm the other blood count before interpreting the 75% gemcitabine band; a value in the omission band takes priority.

rules.explanation: Confirm the other blood count before interpreting the 75% gemcitabine band; a value in the omission band takes priority.

action.recommendation: Confirm the other blood count before interpreting the 75% gemcitabine band; a value in the omission band takes priority.

rules.explanation: Confirm the other blood count before interpreting the 75% gemcitabine band; a value in the omission band takes priority.

action.recommendation: Withhold while the cause of transaminase and bilirubin elevation is established. If there is no alternative cause, the concurrent thresholds require permanent discontinuation. With an alternative explanation apply the AST/ALT pathway (footnote b).

rules.explanation: Withhold while the cause of transaminase and bilirubin elevation is established. If there is no alternative cause, the concurrent thresholds require permanent discontinuation. With an alternative explanation apply the AST/ALT pathway (footnote b).

action.recommendation: Withhold durvalumab for grade 2 immune-mediated meningitis; arrange urgent specialist assessment.

rules.explanation: Withhold durvalumab for grade 2 immune-mediated meningitis; arrange urgent specialist assessment.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue for immune transverse myelitis at any grade, grade 3–4 meningitis, or grade 2–4 encephalitis, myasthenia gravis or Guillain–Barré syndrome.
